name: p1-living-room-tailwind-eu-landscape
description: Living room (Tailwind) on eu-landscape, compiled from projects/living-room-tailwind/project.json by scripts/build-project-hmi.mjs. 17 screens, 99 placements becoming 686 Nextion components, in the theme "tailwind-slate". The base is the minimal eseverson project: one empty page, no fonts, and the same Modelcrc as joBr99's file, which is the NX4832F035_011C this panel is. Pages draw and navigate on their own; the serial protocol to berry/ is not in this step.
program:
int sys0=0,sys1=0,sys2=0
bauds=115200
dim=100
recmod=0
lcd_dev fffb 0002 0000 0020
printh 00 00 00 ff ff ff 88 ff ff ff
page 0
